candidate_ideas.statement: H^{4g-4+n}(PMod_{g,n};Q)=0 for all g>=2 and all n>=1, in particular H^{26}(PMod_{6,6};Q)=0.
H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=0 as a Q-vector space and as a mixed Hodge structure.
The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is isomorphic to the empty direct sum of copies of Q(8) and therefore contains no surviving non-Tate summand.
The evaluation-failure locus Z associated to O_C(Γ)≅W_5⊗ω_C^{-1} is nonempty for (g,n)=(6,6).

Every residual pair on the RED-0001 list with ordinary degree equal to vcd and genus at least two—(3,12),(5,8),(6,6),(7,4),(8,2)—is killed by top-degree rational vanishing of the pure mapping class group.

established_facts.statement: For d=3g-3+n, the open Borel–Moore input W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n};Q) is identified by Poincaré duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n};Q)(d).

established_facts.evidence: packet C66-001-v3 exact target data and numerical setup
established_facts.statement: For (g,n)=(6,6), dim_C M_{6,6}=3g-3+n=21, the ordinary degree 2d-16 equals 26, and the Poincaré twist is 21.

established_facts.evidence: J. Harer, Invent. Math. 84 (1986), 157-176; packet FND-0035 residual bookkeeping
established_facts.statement: Harer: for g>=1 and n>=1, Mod_{g,n} is a virtual duality group of dimension 4g-4+n with dualising module the Steinberg module; in particular vcd(Mod_{6,6})=4g-4+n=26.
For the residual list including (6,6), the ordinary degree 2d-16 equals vcd and never exceeds vcd, so vanishing strictly above vcd cannot resolve the (6,6) target.
For the forgetful map M_{6,6}->M_{6,5}, H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q)=0 because 26 exceeds vcd(M_{6,5})=25; fibre cohomology lives only in degrees 0 and 1.

established_facts.evidence: Serre level-structure representability for l>=3; observable argument Lemma 2.1
established_facts.statement: M_{6,6} admits a presentation as the quotient stack [M_{6,6}[l]/Sp(12,Z/l)] for l>=3, with M_{6,6}[l] a smooth quasi-projective complex variety of pure dimension 21 and the covering map finite étale Galois.

established_facts.evidence: Deligne MHS Poincaré duality; observable argument Lemmas 2.2–2.3 and FND-0001
established_facts.statement: For a smooth complex variety Y of pure dimension d, Poincaré duality supplies H^{BM}_k(Y;Q) ≅ H^{2d-k}(Y;Q)(d) as mixed Hodge structures; applied to the level cover of M_{6,6} with d=21 and G-invariants over Q, H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) ≅ H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21) as MHS, and W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} ≅ (W_{26}H^{26})(21).
For every k, H^k(M_{6,6};Q) ≅ H^k(PMod_{6,6};Q) as Q-vector spaces, via contractibility of Teichmüller space T_{6,6} and the properly discontinuous finite-stabilizer action.

established_facts.evidence: packet target fields ordinary_tate_type Q(-13), open_bm_tate_type Q(8), poincare_twist 21; observable §1 bookkeeping
established_facts.statement: Tate-twist arithmetic for the target: Q(-13)(21)=Q(8), and the weight shift under (21) is -42, matching W_{-16} on Borel–Moore with W_{26} on ordinary cohomology.

established_facts.evidence: packet primary locator SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 and packet degree calculation
established_facts.statement: Casnati–Ekedahl degree formulas: deg(W_{f_i}|_C)=4g+12-4f_i; for g=6 and f=5 one has deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1})=6; equivalently deg(ω_C⊗W_{f_i}^∨(Γ))=4f_i+n-2g-14, which at (g,n)=(6,6) equals 0 for f=5 and -4 for f=4.
The six-point evaluation-failure condition is O_C(Γ) ≅ W_5⊗ω_C^{-1} for the f_2=5 CE summand W_5:=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗γ^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C.

established_facts.evidence: observable argument §0 and Theorem 6.1 categorical reading
established_facts.statement: In the abelian category of Q-mixed Hodge structures, the zero object is the direct sum of the empty family of copies of Q(8), and therefore admits no nonzero (in particular no non-Tate) direct summand.

Church–Farb–Putman, arXiv:1108.0622v3, Theorem 1 establishes top-vcd rational vanishing for Mod_g and additionally for the once-marked and one-boundary-component groups Mod_{g,*} and Mod_{g,1}; it does not state an arbitrary-n theorem for PMod_{g,n}.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The published theorem covers Mod_g, Mod_{g,*}, and Mod_{g,1} only; it supplies no top-vcd vanishing for PMod_{6,6} at degree 4g-4+n=26, so the transport to H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) is unsupported.
invalid_steps.statement: Cite Church–Farb–Putman as proving H^{4g-4+n}(Mod_{g,n};Q)=0 for every n>=1 (with Mod_{g,n} the pure/ordered mapping class group), and conclude H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=0.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The weight-piece and empty-sum conclusions are valid implications from whole-group vanishing, but the premise H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=0 is not established by the cited input, so the conclusions do not follow.
invalid_steps.statement: From the claimed vanishing H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=0, conclude W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q)=0 and hence that the exact group is the empty direct sum of Q(8).

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Equality of ordinary degree with vcd only shows that vanishing strictly above vcd is inert; it does not prove vanishing exactly at vcd for PMod_{g,n}.
invalid_steps.statement: Treat arbitrary-puncture at-vcd vanishing as already available from the residual degree/vcd bookkeeping alone.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: A correct theorem establishing H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=0, or equivalently top-degree rational vanishing H^{4g-4+n}(PMod_{g,n};Q)=0 at (g,n)=(6,6).

If ambient vanishing is unavailable: identification of components, dimensions, stabilizers, and finite-cover behaviour of the evaluation-failure locus Z, and a proof that the exact codimension-13 contribution supported on Z is of Tate type Q(8) (or an exhibited surviving non-Tate summand).

Independent discharge of the geometric sub-dependencies: h^0-stratification of the relative degree-six linear system |W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}|, comparison of determinantal/Fitting ideals with the Abel–Jacobi incidence scheme, and control of Gysin/localisation and monodromy on strata of Z.
